title: How do I build a simple website?
problem_statement: You want a website for yourself, a project or a small business and need to know the realistic options and steps.
expected_outcome: A live website with a home page, an about page and a way to contact you.

steps.title: Decide what the site must do
steps.instructions: List the 3–5 pages you need and what visitors should be able to do (read, contact you, buy).
steps.expected_result: A short page list and goal.

steps.title: Choose your approach
steps.instructions: Self-hosted software like WordPress gives you control and portability but needs hosting and upkeep. A hosted website builder is quicker but less flexible.
steps.expected_result: An approach chosen with its ongoing costs understood.

steps.title: Get hosting and a domain
steps.instructions: For WordPress, choose web hosting and a domain name, then install WordPress (many hosts offer one-click installation).
steps.expected_result: WordPress installed and reachable at your domain.

steps.title: Build your pages
steps.instructions: Pick a simple theme, create your pages and add a contact method.

steps.title: Check and secure
steps.instructions: View the site on a phone and a computer, turn on automatic updates and set up backups.
steps.expected_result: A site that works on mobile and is kept up to date.

quality_checks: Every page loads on a phone.
Updates and backups are switched on.

editorial.author: V2 research pass (AI-assisted, Claude)
editorial.change_summary: Researched from official sources 2026-10-21; published under owner's blanket MVP approval (D-044). Domain-expert review pending.

estimated_time.label: About a day for a first simple site

budget_note: WordPress software is free; hosting and a domain usually cost money.
alternative_methods: Use a hosted website builder if you need a site quickly and don't want to maintain software.
common_mistakes: Installing many plugins you don't need
Not checking the site on a phone
